title: The Injustice
description: You watch someone get blamed for something they didn't do. The crowd goes along with it. You know the truth. Do you speak up?

choices.label: Stand up and tell the truth

outcomes.narration: Your voice shakes but you speak anyway. People turn to look. The accused looks at you with desperate gratitude. It costs you socially, but you sleep well.

choices.label: Stay silent, it's not your fight

outcomes.narration: You look away. Someone else gets punished for your silence. The guilt stays with you, a weight you can't shake.

choices.label: Stay quiet publicly but gather evidence privately

outcomes.narration: You bide your time, collect what you need. A week later you present your evidence to the right authority. The truth comes out. Your way.
